title: DEFER Role
description: A named position that holds authority envelopes. A role is defined independently of the actor holding it. An agent definition never confers authority; only a delegation grant does.

reportsTo.description: Notification and outcome ownership only. Confers no authority and MUST NOT be walked during routing (DEFER 3.2).

items.description: Actor identity. An empty array is a vacant role; its envelopes are unexercisable (DEFER 3.4).

isOwner.description: Exactly one role in a brain may set this. The owner is the terminal approver.

suspended.description: Suspension renders held envelopes unexercisable without revoking any grant (DEFER 8.5).
